scope: Owner-supervised physical signed Nightly trials on primary Pi 4 and Pi 5; automatic installation disabled

picade_observer_interruption.source: Workstation qualification runner, not the native recovery policy
sequence: The first explicit retry selection was refused before installation because network time was not yet usable.
After synchronization, a fresh selection admitted generation-one attempt two.
The observer misclassified the retained previous rolled-back transaction as the new attempt failing.
Its SSH ControlMaster exit closed the installation channel after the Writing record was durable, before a trial reboot.
Confirmed the helper was absent and no reboot parameter was pending; restarted spacewars-recovery.service on the original good normal boot.
Recovery recorded interrupted-before-trial and retained attempt two; a third explicit selection was refused as Quarantined with unchanged history.
Corrected observer transaction matching and used SSH control stop to preserve existing channels; retained original runner bytes.
Published a new qualified image as generation two and used ordinary selection for attempt one without resetting generation-one history.

publisher_cache_fix.observation: Canonical public timestamp URL retained the old CDN redirect after asset replacement; exact-byte verification stopped publication.
publisher_cache_fix.fix: Bind mutable timestamp readback to the validated replacement asset ID on the credential-free public URL, retaining exact length and SHA-256 checks.
publisher_cache_fix.recovery: Resumed the retained generation-one pending publication; no authority, role version or generation reset.
